prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / UI design revision.
Edit this existing Chinese spirit-plant management UI. Preserve its wide 16:9 composition, ink-jade slim header, pale paper information surfaces, precise readable typography, right comparison table, and bottom configuration-preview structure.

The user's corrected core model is: EVERY PROVIDED PLOT STARTS WITH THE SAME BASE CONDITIONS. THE PLAYER MODIFIES EACH PLOT. There are NO innate spring plots, shaded woodland plots, natural rock plots or naturally superior locations. This is an upgrade/configuration management UI.

CHANGE THE LEFT MAP:
Remove the entire natural spring, pool, trees, cliff/rock habitat, forest shade, pre-existing rock bed, and all terrain/habitat labels 泉边 / 林阴 / 岩面 / 向阳畦. Replace with a true directly-overhead ORTHOGRAPHIC farm plan of SIX IDENTICAL STANDARD RECTANGULAR SOIL PLOTS in a neat 3-column by 2-row grid. Each starts with exactly the SAME plain brown soil, rectangular footprint and appearance. Narrow identical earth paths separate them. Keep only a little neutral grass outside the garden perimeter; no objects or tree shadows giving some plots special advantages.
This screenshot is the initial preparation state: ALL SIX PLOTS are as-yet UNMODIFIED. No plants, no rock layer, no irrigation pond in any bed, no random differences in soil. Each plot has a small label 一号田 / 二号田 / 三号田 / 四号田 / 五号田 / 六号田 and a small consistent state “未改造”.
Select 一号田 with a single restrained sage/ochre outline without neon glow. Plots are grounded soil beds, not floating UI cards. STRICT 90-degree straight-down view; rectangular edges aligned with screen, zero perspective skew.
Replace the map's old suitable/improvement legend with a quiet short caption “基础田地” or no legend.
Keep the compact target selector “目标灵植：月露苔”. Map inspection tabs may read “总览” “温度” “水分” “灵力”, with “总览” selected. Do not depict habitat differences before modification.

RIGHT PANEL:
Keep heading “环境对照” and ALL FIVE rows of the existing table unchanged:
条件 / 地块环境 / 灵草需求 / 判定
温度 / 偏暖 / 凉润 / 偏离
灵力 / 偏低 / 充足 / 不足
水分 / 湿润 / 湿润 / 满足
光照 / 直射 / 遮阴 / 过强
基质 / 普通土层 / 阴湿岩面 / 缺少
Replace “西侧圃地 · 月露苔” with “一号田 · 月露苔”.
Replace the “停长” badge with “待改造” because this is pre-planting configuration.
Replace the reason area's current copy with:
“当前尚未满足种植条件”
“请先配置地块改造”
Replace its “查看培护” button with “改造方案”.
The player is choosing how to modify a standard starting plot for this target plant, not searching for better natural terrain.

BOTTOM WORKBENCH:
Rename main heading “基质配置” to “地块改造”, context “一号田”.
Add a clear compact set of modification-category tabs “基质” “控温” “水分” “光照” “聚灵”, with “基质” selected.
Within the active substrate area, keep a smaller material-category selector “腐殖” “岩质” “遗骸”, with “岩质” selected and “遗骸” visually inactive for a future category. Fit this compactly near the material selection without shrinking main text.
Keep the actual current/base and preview contents:
“当前基底” / “普通土层” with soil thumbnail
“待加入” / “岩质基质” with flat-rock material thumbnail
“配置预览”
“基质缺项可补足”
“温度、光照与灵力仍需处理”
Buttons “预览配置” and “清空选择”.
No substrate has actually been applied yet; the selected plot stays plain soil until a real confirmation. Preview clearly only supplies one required condition; other issues remain.
Keep this workbench shallower than the main map and comparison region.

No invented prices, quantities, degree values, concentration numbers, failure timers or yield scores. The six plots are layout examples, not formal gameplay capacity. No giant brush-stroke banners, no playable characters, no natural terrain bonuses, no gore, no new decorative scenery, no English text, no watermark. One polished readable finished game UI ideal image.
